name: MarketingHeader
description: Mortar marketing marketing header, using central semantic tokens. Link groups open a flyout panel (Headless UI Popover).

props.links: HeaderLink[] (LinkAction | { label: string; items: FlyoutItem[]; footer?: LinkAction[]; layout?: "list" | "columns" | "full" }; a group's layout picks its flyout: list (default) one column, columns a wider two-column panel, full a panel as wide as the viewport allows (up to 1248px) with up to four columns; footer is a row of actions under the items)
props.layout: "inline" | "center" (default "inline"; center puts the links at the start, the brand in the middle and the actions at the end, in that DOM order)
props.mobileMenu: "inline" | "panel" (default "inline"; panel makes the narrow-screen menu button open a full-screen dialog with the links, groups as disclosures, and the actions)

contract.usage: Import { MarketingHeader } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook. The menu button controls a navigation element with a generated id. With mobileMenu="panel" it has aria-haspopup="dialog" and opens a modal dialog titled with the brand; Escape or Close menu closes it and returns focus to the button.
